name: Found
description: In any given year, more than 600,000 people are reported missing in the U.S. Of these reported cases, more than half of the missing people are people of color, too easily neglected by the system. Gabi Mosely, a former missing person herself, now specializes in PR and leads a crisis management team that seeks out these missing people. But unbeknownst to anyone, Mosely is hiding a dark secret of her own.

videos.title: Pilot
videos.overview: Crisis management specialist Gabi Mosely and her team's search for Camilla, a missing 14-year-old in foster care, becomes more complicated than they initially suspected.

videos.title: Missing While Sinning
videos.overview: The team mobilizes to search for Jinny Coe, a personal escort who disappeared near her apartment. News anchor Joy-Ann Reid launches a nationwide search for “Sir,” who abducted Gabi and Bella when they were young. Dhan makes a breakthrough with Zeke.

videos.title: Missing While Widowed
videos.overview: The team launches an investigation for widower Reggie Moore at the request of the doorman at Reggie's building. Gabi comes to a realization about her time with Lacey. Margaret hopes to repair her relationship with someone important from her past.

videos.title: Missing While a Pawn
videos.overview: When 13-year-old Matthew disappears from church, the teams spring into action. Gabi endeavors to keep the divorced parents focused on the search. Gabi is forced to make a devastating choice. Lacey makes a keen observation about Gabi.

videos.title: Missing While Undocumented
videos.overview: The M&A team mobilizes to trace the last steps of 21-year-old Satcha Moncado before she disappeared, knowing her undocumented status makes her more vulnerable. Their search uncovers a greater threat that nearly claims the life of one of our own.

videos.title: Missing While Addicted
videos.overview: When Gabi takes the case of a missing man on behalf of his mother, it causes disagreement among the team. Gabi's dogged pursuit of the truth leads to a shocking revelation.

videos.title: Missing While Indigenous
videos.overview: Native American schoolteacher Denae Wagon decides to deliver her baby on the tribe's reservation in Virginia but disappears before she can make it home. The search is complicated by a tense family dynamic and Denae's high-risk pregnancy.

videos.title: Missing While Homeless
videos.overview: Dhan spearheads the search for a missing unhoused man who's been an integral part of a tight-knit encampment; when Detective Trent shares troubling news about Sir, Gabi goes to great lengths to protect her secret.

videos.title: Missing While Scamming
videos.overview: A social media influencer is kidnapped for ransom. As the team searches for clues, the case becomes more complicated than anticipated. Lacey confronts Gabi about their faltering friendship. Sir remembers troubling moments from his past.

videos.title: Missing While Indoctrinated
videos.overview: Gabi and the team revisit a previous case involving child trafficking, and their heated investigation leads them in a shocking direction. Gabi confronts Sir about another one of his possible victims.

videos.title: Missing While Interracial
videos.overview: When a black man goes missing, his family turns to M&A, but suspicions begin to swirl when he's implicated in the disappearance of a White woman. Gabi digs in on her search for Annie, the girl she saw at the cabin. Sir reveals why he kidnapped Gabi.

videos.title: Missing While Eccentric
videos.overview: When a confused and battered young woman lands on Zeke's doorstep and says she was kidnapped and her abductor still has her friends, the team races to put the minimal clues together. Gabi shares devastating news with Dhan.

videos.title: Missing While Forgotten
videos.overview: Gabi unravels as the team receives an anonymous tip about one of its most important cases – a missing girl they've been tracking for months. Gabi makes a shocking discovery about Sir.

videos.title: Missing While Bait
videos.overview: Gabi and her team at Mosely & Associates begin to spiral amid Gabi's shocking revelation. Lacey's childhood flashbacks begin to resurface, providing vital clues as Sir remains at large.

videos.title: Missing While Difficult
videos.overview: A Black newborn baby is abducted from the hospital while Gabi and the team continue their frantic search for one of their own; someone from Sir's past pays Mosely & Associates a surprise visit; Margaret has a public meltdown.

videos.title: Missing While Lonely
videos.overview: An elderly widower engaged to a murderer disappears on her wedding day; Trent reveals new findings surrounding the death of Sir's mother; Gabi baits Sir with a game of cat and mouse and navigates the fallout within her Mosely & Associates family.

videos.title: Missing While Perfect
videos.overview: As Lacey attempts to readjust to life after her kidnapping, the fractured M&A team assists a 15-year-old boy in finding his missing parents; Sir begins making plans for the future; Trent is forced to make a decision with a case of his own.

videos.title: Missing While Presumed Dead
videos.overview: Margaret reopens a teenage girl's missing-person case after an unidentified 4-year-old boy appears in the D.C. area; Lacey recalls a memory from her kidnapping that leads to a clue in the manhunt for Sir; Gabi makes plans to right her wrongs.

videos.title: Missing While Gabi Mosely
videos.overview: The team investigates a missing girl named Gabi Mosely but questions the motivations behind her disappearance; Dhan tries to rally M&A back together; Margaret faces a setback in her search for Jamie; Sir takes an interest in a missing persons case.

videos.title: Missing While Hated
videos.overview: M&A investigates a potential hate crime when a non-binary activist disappears; Gabi's recollection of memories from the past opens up old wounds; Trent hones in on Sir's potential accomplice; Zeke crosses a dangerous line with the DCPD.

videos.title: Missing While Haunted
videos.overview: Margaret's struggle to suppress memories of Jamie's disappearance triggers emotions she can't ward off; M&A works to track down a mother with a mental illness who has vanished; Zeke's agoraphobia is triggered by an unwanted guest.

videos.title: Missing While Targeted
videos.overview: When a recovering drug addict goes missing, his girlfriend turns to M&A, but interference from outside forces complicates their investigation. Sir uncovers a shocking secret about one of M&A's allies. One of the team members is critically injured.

videos.title: Missing While Outed
videos.overview: A college student disappears after a fraternity prank outs him as gay and M&A mobilizes to trace his whereabouts. The pressure for Gabi's arrest reaches a boiling point. Sir becomes increasingly bold in his quest for Gabi.

videos.title: Missing While Misunderstood
videos.overview: M&A races against the clock to search for a missing Black, non-neurotypical boy before he suffers from an emotional breakdown. The cat-and-mouse game between Sir and Gabi comes to a head. Margaret is approached by a familiar face.

videos.title: Missing While Misidentified
videos.overview: The past and present collide when the truth is revealed of how Sir's captivity began. New information on Jamie raises questions about his abduction. Gabi struggles to make amends as the case against her evolves. Sir makes a confession.

videos.title: Missing While Grieving
videos.overview: When an elderly, blind man is accused of kidnapping his sister, M&A mounts an investigation to dig deeper; tension around Jamie's identity causes friction among M&A; a surprising death stirs suspicion around Sir's accomplice.

videos.title: Missing While Matched
videos.overview: A 911 call tips M&A off to a young woman who has gone missing after a date. Lacey considers starting a new relationship. Sir takes drastic measures to capture Gabi's attention. Margaret and Gabi investigate potential suspects in Jamie's kidnapping.

videos.title: Missing While Seeking Asylum
videos.overview: The search for missing undocumented children sheds light on secrets from decades ago as M&A uncovers clues in their disappearances. Zeke grapples with expressing his feelings to someone close to him. Sir receives unwavering support from a visitor.

videos.title: Missing While Witnessed
videos.overview: When an EMT is abducted in broad daylight, M&A's investigation creates more questions than answers. Margaret reflects on her behavior after Jamie disappeared. Trent makes a tough choice when Heather finds herself involved in a case close to M&A.

videos.title: Missing While Manipulated
videos.overview: An emotional father takes drastic measures to find his missing son, causing Gabi to be caught in his crosshairs. M&A races against the clock to uncover the truth. Margaret makes a shocking revelation about Sir's accomplice.

videos.title: Missing While Heather
videos.overview: When severe weather causes mayhem across D.C., M&A is impacted by the effects of the storm as their search for Heather escalates. Margaret confronts a familiar face in connection to Jamie's abduction. Zeke and Lacey's relationship is tested.

videos.title: Missing While a Casualty
videos.overview: M&A attempts to find a father who was reported deceased and is the only viable organ donor for his ailing son. New details around Sir's accomplice fuels the manhunt for their arrest. Details of Jamie's childhood kidnapping are revealed.

videos.title: Missing While Independent
videos.overview: A missing person flyer draws Margaret into a case about a missing woman with Down syndrome. Previously missing persons from M&A's old cases resurface. Sir negotiates the terms of his case. Dhan makes headway in determining Jamie's identity.

videos.title: Missing While a Family
videos.overview: M&A is approached about a missing family from a Jewish Modern Orthodox congregation. Margaret shares her recent experiences with her family. Sir sets a plan in motion for his and Gabi's future. An M&A ally is put in jeopardy.

videos.title: Missing While Dying
videos.overview: Someone from Dhan's past resurfaces, looking for their missing wife and triggering Dhan's trauma. M&A mobilizes to track down one of their own as Gabi barters with her life. Heather's actions lead to a bold declaration.
